meta.name: command-creator
meta.description: Create Claude Code custom slash commands with proper structure, frontmatter, and best practices. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create a new command, add a slash command, build a custom command, or mentions "create-command", "new command", "add command", or "make a command" for Claude Code. Also trigger when the user wants to turn a workflow into a reusable command.

copy.tagline: 把重复工作流变成可复用的斜杠命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Claude Code 里做重复操作想一键完成
copy.tagline_en: Turn repetitive workflows into reusable slash commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat operations in Claude Code and want to do them with one command

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的需求创建自定义斜杠命令。它会生成一个 Markdown 文件，包含命令说明、参数提示和步骤，让你能通过输入 /命令名 来重复执行复杂任务。
howto.when: 当你说“创建一个新命令”、“添加斜杠命令”或提到“create-command”、“new command”等关键词时触发。也适用于你想把工作流程变成可复用命令时。

say.text: 帮我创建一个命令，用来审查 GitHub 上的 PR。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 review-pr 命令文件。

say.text: 创建一个新命令，用来格式化代码并运行测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个包含格式化与测试步骤的命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates custom slash commands based on your needs. It generates a Markdown file with description, argument hints, and steps, allowing you to repeat complex tasks by typing /command-name.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'create a new command', 'add a slash command', or mention 'create-command', 'new command', etc. Also when you want to turn a workflow into a reusable command.

say_en.text: Create a command to review GitHub pull requests.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a review-pr command file.

say_en.text: Create a new command to format code and run tests.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a command with formatting and testing steps.
